summary_en: 402,100 shares (4.6% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-12. Upper limit ¥1,264.6M. Execution at 2026-06-12 08:45 JST at previous day close (¥3,145/share). Results to be disclosed immediately post-trade.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-market trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-11, Chiyoda Integre's board authorized acquisition of up to 402,100 treasury shares (4.6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading on 2026-06-12. The upper limit for acquisition is ¥1,264.6M. The company will place a buy order at the previous day's closing price (¥3,145) at 08:45 JST on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Results will be published immediately following the trade window close. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns under the medium-term business plan and to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. The purchase is structured as a single-day block trade with no amendments to the share count permitted, though full execution is not guaranteed due to market conditions.
